findings.explanation: Detailed implementation duplicates steps 1-4 and appends generic modular input/HEC boilerplate that contradicts the SQL Server audit file ingestion guidance.
findings.quote:
Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (DB Connect, SQL Server audit — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=mssql:audit into database. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the duplicated boilerplate block and consolidate into a single SQL Server audit configuration walkthrough.

summary: Damaged by title salad fragments, self-referential value statements, duplicated boilerplate implementation sections, and generic exception registers.
